jobs.occupation: Order Picker at AS Watson in Heteren (Arnhem) (113871003)
jobs.description: As an order picker at AS Watson in Heteren, you’re always on the move. You collect products using a voice pick system: your headset tells you where to go, you grab the right product, and confirm it. You walk a lot, lift small and large packages, and make sure everything ends up in the right place. You work in a 2- or 3-shift system, depending on your preference. This means sometimes you start early, sometimes later, but you always have time for yourself. In this role as warehouse worker or logistics employee, you really make an impact: thanks to you, thousands of people can shop daily at Kruidvat, Trekpleister, and ICI Paris XL.- You speak Dutch or English- You can handle physical work- You’re available to work at least one Saturday every four weeks- You choose either a 2- or 3-shift system- You live a maximum of 30 km from Heteren

Do you thrive on precision engineering and complex machining processes? Are you an experienced machinist who can independently program, set up, and operate CNC machines? Do you enjoy producing high-quality components and working in a technically challenging environment? Then this opportunity could be the perfect next step in your career. For an internationally operating machine manufacturer, we are looking for an Allround CNC Machinist / Machining Operator. In this role, you will be responsible for the complete machining process, from programming and setup to production and quality control. What will you be doing? As an Allround Machinist, you will work in a modern machining department equipped with conventional, teach-in, and CNC-controlled machines. You will independently manufacture precision components based on technical drawings and specifications. Your responsibilities include: Programming CNC machines using Edgecam or similar CAM software Setting up and operating conventional, teach-in, and CNC machines Performing milling and turning operations on high-quality components Conducting dimensional inspections and quality checks Monitoring product quality and manufacturing tolerances Performing routine machine maintenance Troubleshooting and resolving minor technical issues Working according to safety and quality procedures Arbeidsvoorwaarden What can you expect? A challenging role within an internationally operating engineering company The opportunity to work on high-quality machine components and technical projects A modern and well-equipped machining environment Excellent opportunities for professional growth and development An open and collaborative company culture Working alongside highly skilled technical professionals A competitive salary of up to approximately €4,500 gross per month, depending on experience 27 vacation days plus 13 additional leave (ADV) days Strong secondary employment benefits Functie-eisen Technical education at MBO level or equivalenpreferably in Machining, Manufacturing, or Mechanical Engineering Extensive experience with CNC milling and CNC turning Experience operating teach-in machines Knowledge of conventional turning techniques Experience with Edgecam or comparable CAM software Strong understanding of materials and machining processes Ability to read and interpret technical drawings independently Good communication skills in both Dutch and English Accurate, independent, and results-driven working style Flexible and willing to work across different machines and departments Team-oriented mindset with a proactive attitude Hier kom je te werken You will be working for an internationally operating organization in the mechanical engineering industry. The company specializes in the design and manufacture of technical installations and machinery for customers worldwide. Within the organization, engineering excellence, quality, and craftsmanship are at the core of everything they do, and you will collaborate with experienced colleagues in a professional working environment.
